verdict.rationale: Greptile's own background automation is PR-triggered review. Once connected with review triggers configured, it automatically reviews every pull request, and per-PR features such as test generation and TREX sandbox runs post their results without a human starting them. These are fixed, event-driven code-review workflows, not general user-defined automations. Missing for 10: user-authored custom automation workflows, scheduled or recurring jobs beyond PR events, documentation of trigger configuration depth, and independent hands-on corroboration of unattended operation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Greptile is an AI code review agent that automatically reviews every pull request with complete understanding of your codebase.
Connect GitHub or GitLab, configure review triggers, and get automated feedback on your first pull request.
Configure Greptile's review strictness, filter comment types, ignore files, and configure triggers.
Automatically generate unit tests for new and changed code in every PR
TREX runs your PR branch in a sandbox to find the bugs that only show up at runtime.
